patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct peaks visible near 1830-1835 separated by an intervening trough around 1775-1780. Price is currently declining from the second peak toward the neckline at approximately 1808.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price formed two similar highs around 1830-1835 with a pullback low near 1775 between them. Current price is retreating from the second high but remains above the neckline support zone.
limitations: Pattern confirmation requires a decisive close below neckline; the latest candle may still be forming; chart resolution limits precise wick and body analysis.
